METADATA ONLY (not on-screen evidence): {'logline': 'When rumors of the poisoned Duchess begin spreading among the servants, Rupert and Catherine conspire with an elder nobleman to fabricate a witchcraft charge against Juliana, sealing her fate for the gallows.', 'continuity_notes': "Follows directly from Episode 29 where Juliana was locked away in the castle's subterranean wet cells, vowing never to let them take Alexander from her."}

SCENE sc_001 0-47600 INT. CASTLE CORRIDOR – DAY
EP30:E1 0-5200 CAMERA: Low-angle tracking shot following polished black dress shoes and the tip of a gold-handled cane striding deliberately along a sunlit marble hallway, tilting up gradually to reveal an austere, grey-haired elder nobleman.
EP30:E2 0-4500 SOUND: Rhythmic, heavy footsteps and the sharp metallic click of a cane striking the polished stone floor.
EP30:E3 3000-5500 ACTION: The Elder Nobleman walks with stern, unhurried authority, dressed in an immaculate black tailcoat and dark vest with a gold pocket watch chain.
EP30:E4 5200-7500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Rupert standing nervously beside ornate double doors, wearing black gloves and an embroidered dark coat, glancing up with anxiety.
EP30:E5 6800-7900 SOUND: A firm tap of the wooden walking stick halting against the floor.
EP30:E6 7500-13500 CAMERA: Two-shot profile of the Elder Nobleman facing Rupert in the vaulted corridor.
EP30:E7 8800-13300 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Cold, Accusatory]: "You have a rat in your cellar, Rupert. And the servants are beginning to smell it."
EP30:E8 13500-16900 CAMERA: Close-up of Rupert defensive and agitated.
EP30:E9 13600-16800 RUPERT [Defensive, Anxious]: "The Ashcroft girl is locked tight. Nobody knows she is down there."
EP30:E10 16900-26000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman fixing Rupert with a piercing, contemptuous glare.
EP30:E11 17300-25800 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Stern, Disapproving]: "The kitchen maids are whispering. They see the soup bowls returned unwiped. They see your guards outside the lower grates."
EP30:E12 26000-29800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Rupert looking down, nervously pulling at his black leather gloves as dread creeps over his face.
EP30:E13 26500-29200 RUPERT [Muttered, Paranoid]: "She knows the Duchess was poisoned."
EP30:E14 29800-32000 CAMERA: Tight close-up on the Elder Nobleman's unyielding eyes narrowing in cold calculation.
EP30:E15 32000-33400 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Rupert swallows hard, breathless with dread.
EP30:E16 32100-33300 RUPERT [Fearful]: "If she speaks..."
EP30:E17 33400-39800 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as the Elder Nobleman lunges forward aggressively, stepping into Rupert's personal space.
EP30:E18 33400-35200 ACTION: The Elder Nobleman thrusts the gold knob of his walking stick directly against Rupert's chest, pinning him against the wall.
EP30:E19 33600-39800 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Fierce, Venomous]: "Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!"
EP30:E20 39800-43800 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Rupert gasping softly, intimidated by the cane pressed firmly beneath his cravat.
EP30:E21 41800-43500 RUPERT [Faltering, Submissive]: "What are you suggesting?"
EP30:E22 43800-47600 CAMERA: Medium shot as the Elder Nobleman withdraws his cane and turns sharply toward the library doors.
EP30:E23 44800-47300 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Calculated, Ominous]: "We stop hiding the prisoner."
SCENE sc_002 47600-144500 INT. CASTLE STUDY / LIBRARY – CONTINUOUS
EP30:E24 47600-51000 CAMERA: Tracking shot from behind the Elder Nobleman as he pushes open the heavy double doors into the dark wood-paneled library.
EP30:E25 48000-50500 SOUND: The heavy creak of massive mahogany doors gliding open on brass hinges.
EP30:E26 51000-54600 CAMERA: Front medium shot of the Elder Nobleman pausing inside the library doorway, Rupert following behind him.
EP30:E27 51200-54000 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Deadpan, Sinister]: "We give them a reason to condemn her."
EP30:E28 54600-58800 CAMERA: Wide shot of Catherine standing regally before the roaring stone hearth, dressed in an ornate burgundy and gold brocade gown, slowly unfurling a red lace fan.
EP30:E29 57000-58800 CATHERINE [Inquiring, Sharp]: "You have a solution?"
EP30:E30 58800-62800 CAMERA: Side profile close-up of the Elder Nobleman speaking with icy confidence.
EP30:E31 59400-62500 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Ruthless]: "We use the law to destroy her."
EP30:E32 62800-64800 CAMERA: Close-up of Rupert looking bewildered.
EP30:E33 63100-64300 RUPERT [Confused]: "The law?"
EP30:E34 64800-73500 CAMERA: Tracking medium shot as the Elder Nobleman paces slowly behind the massive mahogany desk lined with books and a glass of whiskey.
EP30:E35 65300-72800 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Pragmatic, Scheming]: "A maid with herbs in her possession, a secret medicine, an unauthorized visit to the Duchess's chamber."
EP30:E36 70800-73200 ACTION: The Elder Nobleman leans both hands against the desk, leaning forward intently.
EP30:E37 73500-74800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine fluttering her fan beneath her chin, smirking approvingly.
EP30:E38 74800-82800 CAMERA: Medium shot framing the Elder Nobleman seated at the desk beside Catherine standing in the firelight.
EP30:E39 75000-82500 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Cold, Calculating]: "Give those facts to a magistrate in the right order, and she becomes a poisoner."
EP30:E40 82800-85600 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine gently moving her fan, raising an intrigued brow.
EP30:E41 83200-85400 CATHERINE [Curious, Conniving]: "And if she claims she is a healer?"
EP30:E42 85600-88500 CAMERA: Tight close-up of the Elder Nobleman's face illuminated by warm firelight.
EP30:E43 85800-87800 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Sinister]: "Then call it witchcraft."
EP30:E44 88500-91800 CAMERA: Close-up of Rupert wide-eyed with shock at the severity of the plan.
EP30:E45 89000-91300 RUPERT [Stunned]: "Witchcraft is a capital charge."
EP30:E46 91800-94500 CAMERA: Straight-on close-up of the Elder Nobleman staring back without a flicker of remorse.
EP30:E47 92000-93400 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Unflinching]: "Precisely."
EP30:E48 94500-101900 CAMERA: Medium three-shot framing Rupert, the Elder Nobleman between them, and Catherine listening closely.
EP30:E49 94600-101800 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Authoritative, Command]: "Do not hide the evidence, manufacture it. Drag her before the magistrate tomorrow, frame the trial, buy the jury, and let the State hang her."
EP30:E50 101900-104400 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine smiling with malicious satisfaction, fluttering her fan.
EP30:E51 102200-103900 CATHERINE [Scheming]: "Her botanical ledger..."
EP30:E52 104400-106600 CAMERA: Close-up of the Elder Nobleman nodding slowly.
EP30:E53 104800-106000 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Confirming]: "Exactly."
EP30:E54 106600-109000 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward.
EP30:E55 107300-108800 CATHERINE [Inquiring]: "And the Dowager?"
EP30:E56 109000-116800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Elder Nobleman gesturing dismissively with one gloved hand.
EP30:E57 109500-116500 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Dismissive]: "She is weak, confused. No magistrate will trust a dying woman's accusations against a respected household."
EP30:E58 116800-121900 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Rupert exhaling deeply, processing the horrifying certainty of their conspiracy.
EP30:E59 120000-121500 RUPERT [Hesitant]: "And Juliana?"
EP30:E60 121900-125100 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman staring sternly across the desk.
EP30:E61 122400-124900 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Cold, Resolute]: "She goes before the magistrate tomorrow."
EP30:E62 125100-133500 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine beaming with venomous glee, spreading her red fan wide.
EP30:E63 125500-133000 CATHERINE [Cruel, Exultant]: "She will hang. A perfect solution. The town will cheer as the witch's disgraced daughter faces the noose."
EP30:E64 133500-136800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Rupert pulling out the desk chair and seating himself with dark resolve.
EP30:E65 134100-136200 RUPERT [Resolute, Vengeful]: "I will write the arrest warrant myself."
EP30:E66 136800-144500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of the Elder Nobleman's weathered face, his eyes cold and predatory in the firelight.
EP30:E67 137500-143500 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Chilling, Decisive]: "Tomorrow, she stops being a prisoner. She becomes a witch."
SCENE sc_003 144500-151210 INT. CASTLE SUBTERRANEAN WET CELLS – NIGHT
EP30:E68 144500-148500 CAMERA: High-angle shot peering down through the heavy iron dungeon grate into the flooded, pitch-black subterranean wet cells where water drips continuously.
EP30:E69 144500-151210 SOUND: Echoing, hollow water droplets splashing into dark pools beneath stone vaults, accompanied by a somber orchestral swell.
EP30:E70 148500-151210 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot pushing in on Juliana huddled against the wet stone wall, chained by the wrists, shivering in wet rags as faint moonlight filters down through the grate above.
EP30:E71 148500-151210 ACTION: Juliana clutches a rough burlap rag to her trembling chest, her tear-stained face lifting upward in dread and fragile hope as the frame holds, cutting abruptly to black.
